desc: The compact, yet rough-looking, Roughneck is a new type of Bond Arm gun. It's built with a 2.5? barrel chambered for 9mm, 357/38 or 45ACP. Works best with smoothed lined holsters. Features: Stainless steel double-barrel and frame. Compatible with all standard Bond Arms barrels. Patented rebounding hammer. Retracting firing pins. Cross-bolt safety. Spring-loaded, cammed locking lever.
